Alex (AE): Heads up — Northbridge renewal in ~30 days. They want to rebaseline usage and increase committed units from 80k/mo to 120k/mo.
Priya (CSM): They signaled cost concerns; asked if we can hold last year's rate and give a loyalty uplift discount.
Alex (AE): They want a 10% price protection on existing SKUs and a one-time credit for overages during POC.
Jordan (Deal Desk): Need current ARR, current committed units, and contract term remaining. Also, any prior concessions?
Sam (RevOps): Current ARR $380k, commit 80k/mo, 6 months left on term. Prior concession: 5% promotional discount at signup.
Maria (Solutions Eng): On the POC side, usage spiked due to misconfigured batching — we can recommend batching + quantization to reduce token spend by ~18%. Will produce a short SOW for optimization work.
Alex (AE): Is Deal Desk comfortable with a 10% rate hold + 5% loyalty for multi-year if they commit to 12 months at 120k/mo?
Jordan (Deal Desk): 10% flat is above standard. We need approval for >7% list discount. Also need to tie any concession to committed MRR in the amendment.
Jordan (Deal Desk): Please prepare a short term sheet with fields: `commit: 120k/mo`, `term: 12 months`, `discount: 7% base + 3% loyalty (conditional)`, `one-time credit: $15k cap`, `SLA uplift: standard`.
Priya (CSM): I'll confirm customer appetite for 12 months and flag any regulatory constraints (data residency asks).
renewal-bot: Reminder: Renewal #NB-2024-06-18 - owner @Alex (AE) — renewal stage: negotiating — link https://app.crm/renewals/NB-2024
Sam (RevOps): If Deal Desk approves conditional 3% loyalty, we also need billing codes to track the credit and a clause for overage reconciliation.
Jordan (Deal Desk): Agreed. I'll queue this for approval meeting — please drop the term sheet and historical discount memo in this thread and @me. If legal needs to adjust T&Cs, loop them in.
Alex (AE): Will draft the term sheet + short note on POC fixes from Maria and post by EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:
